title: Refactor Ticket Plan Mechanism

iterations.prompt: The ticket mechanism should change in repo go file: When a plan is provided by the user, then move the original plan file (keep the file name) to the ticket folder and add the plan to the ticket.json. Dont create the plan_ITERATION.md files anymore. Everything else should be now part of ticket.md.
iterations.author: usalu

iterations.prompt: The author string that is put to ticket.json should first try to find one of the contributors in the `.semio-repo/contributors/` if one of the emails match. If a match is found, use the GitHub username as author. If no match is found, use the git config NAME <EMAIL> format.
iterations.author: usalu

iterations.prompt: All tests for tickets are not cleaning up the tickets afterwards.
iterations.author: usalu

iterations.prompt: Create ticket shouldn't throw an error on a title like "Refactor Resource ID System to Bundle-Based Hierarchy". Only throw if the title is equal to the lower or uppercase slug: "refactor-resource-id-system-to-bundle-based-hierarchy" or "REFACTOR-RESOURCE-ID-SYSTEM-TO-BUNDLE-BASED-HIERARCHY". Extend tests. Make sure all tests cleanup created tickets and no GitHub issues are created.
iterations.author: usalu

iterations.prompt: Make ticket CLI support flexible argument passing: positional args (gemini-3-pro copilot-chat), flags (--gemini-3-pro --copilot-chat), named values (--llm gemini-3-pro --ui copilot-chat), and mixtures of all three.
iterations.author: usalu

iterations.prompt: The repo MCP should not use the JSON API but the same output format as the CLI.
iterations.author: usalu

summary: Refactored the ticket mechanism: (1) No longer creates empty plan.md files when no plan is provided. (2) Fixed author lookup to correctly use ListContributors() and match by email. (3) Added test cleanup. (4) Verified title validation. (5) Added flexible CLI argument parsing. (6) Changed MCP to use CLI-style output instead of JSON.
